items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I just returned from St. Louis working a season on the boat with Charlie Crep... [INTERVIEWEE] Like that.

ctx.x: Try one more. I don't have good equipment here for a camera, it doesn't synchronize, I have to open up the bulb, and then flash it. Let's see, it's simple. I guess I can turn this thing off. Whoops, speaker's on. This is, I'll make a note here. See if this is going up. This is continuing the Al Wynn interview. Okay, we're ready to go. You can talk, I asked about either Louis Armstrong or Jimmy Noon, some of the other bands. Yeah.

Well, I just returned from St. Louis working a season on the boat with Charlie Crep. And things were pretty bad musically in Chicago at that time. And Louis was here, and he was just beginning to reach his popularity. He was just beginning to get into it. So he got an idea to get a band, form a band, and lease several dance halls, and this alternate weekly. Yes.
